terms.gloss: a stopping place: a bus stop
terms.comment: Our use, as in the lexicon’s statiō ferriviāria (train station): classically a place where one stands or waits (Lewis & Short; stationēs, public places where people sit about, Plin. Ep. 1.13.2). In full, statiō autoraedārum longārum, after Traupman’s hōrārium autoraedārum longārum (bus timetable, p. 218). No reference work has a word for a bus stop.

phrases.latin: Ad statiōnem currāmus; autoraeda longa venit!
phrases.english: Let’s run to the bus stop; the bus is coming!

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 218.
